Name: Old Mariner Gives the Mermaid Her Pendant Back
Author: DolphinIsNotaFish
Description:
This mod replaces the Old Mariner with a Mermaid, complete with her own custom dialogue. She would also have her own portrait if you have[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35358] [i]Portraits for Extras[/i][/url] installed.

[b]For modders[/b]: I meant this as some sort of an example on how to customize portraits for the Mariner. If you are making a mod that alters the Mariner and want to add your own portraits, feel free to take a peek on this mod's json to see how it's done.

[size=6][b]L[/b][/size][size=5][b]atest Update
[/b][/size]Added special compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23169][i]Swim - Continued[/i][/url] that makes one of the secret places it can reach a mermaid's retreat, with map forged by the wonderful [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/158243283]Tenebrous Nova[/url].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/liIe2WA.gif[/img] 

[b][color=#ffe599][size=6]S[/size][/color][size=5][color=#ffe599]pecial Mod Interactions[/color][/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35358][i]Portraits for Extras[/i][/url] does what it says on the tin. If you have it installed, the mermaid would also have portraits.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22188][i]Seasonal Mermaid's Pendant[/i][/url] alters the pendant's appearance into several pretty designs that change according to seasons. If you have it installed, the mermaid would also wear this changing pendant.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22799][i]Seasonal Mariner To Mermaid[/i][/url] introduces four mermaids in place of the mariner. With it installed, my mermaid will join them, appearing during stormy days.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10758][i]Maritime Secrets[/i][/url] gives hints to the game's various secrets and hidden mechanics, giving you a reason to visit the beach regularly. If you have the mod installed, the mermaid would have her own unique flavor lines.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23169][i]Swim - Continued[/i][/url] provides the ability to swim and dive to reach various secret locations. One of them would be the mermaid's retreat.
[/list][color=#b6d7a8]﻿[b][size=6]I[/size][size=5]nstallation[/size][/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][i]Content Patcher[/i][/url]﻿ installed.
[*]Download [b][i]Give the Mermaid Her Pendant Back[/i][/b].
[*]Extract the downloaded file into the game's [font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Mods[/font] folder.
[/list]To uninstall, simply delete [font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Give the Mermaid Her Pendant Back[/font] from your Mods folder.

[b][color=#a2c4c9][size=6]C[/size][size=5]ompatibility[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Only works with [i]Stardew Valley[/i] version 1.6 and later.
[*]Will conflict with any mod that alters the Old Mariner's appearance except [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22799][i]Seasonal Mariner To Mermaid[/i][/url], which has special interaction with this mod.
[/list][b][color=#9fc5e8][size=6]T[/size][size=5]ranslations[/size][/color][/b][size=5]
[/size]This mod uses i18n. If you want to make a translation for it, feel free to either give it to me (so I could incorporate it into the mod) or upload them yourself (do tell me so I can link to them!).
